title: SCR 1046 (2022 - Fifty-fifth Legislature - Second Regular Session (azleg session id 125)): voter identification; Arizona card
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id)
(section) Bill text
(quote) REFERENCE TITLE: voter identification; Arizona card
(section) Bill text
(quote) ENACTING AND ORDERING THE SUBMISSION TO THE PEOPLE OF A MEASURE RELATING TO VOTER IDENTIFICATION.
(section) Bill text (para 1)
(quote) 1. Under the power of the referendum, as vested in the Legislature, the following measure, relating to voter identification, is enacted to become valid as a law if approved by the voters and on proclamation of the Governor:
(section) Bill text
(quote) AMENDING SECTION 16-579, ARIZONA REVISED STATUTES; AMENDING TITLE 16, CHAPTER 4, ARTICLE 9, ARIZONA REVISED STATUTES, BY ADDING SECTION 16-567; RELATING TO VOTER IDENTIFICATION.
(section) Sec. 1: Section 16-579, Arizona Revised Statutes, is amended to read:
(quote) (a) An Arizona driver license, an Arizona nonoperating identification license or an Arizona voter photo identification card issued as prescribed in SECTION 16-567.
(section) Sec. 2: Title 16, chapter 4, article 9, Arizona Revised Statutes, is amended by adding section 16-567, to read:
(quote) Arizona voter photo identification card; secretary of state
(section) Sec. 2: Title 16, chapter 4, article 9, Arizona Revised Statutes, is amended by adding section 16-567, to read: (para A)
(quote) The Arizona voter photo identification card shall contain all of the following information:
(section) Sec. 2: Title 16, chapter 4, article 9, Arizona Revised Statutes, is amended by adding section 16-567, to read: (para 5)
(quote) 5. The date on which the secretary of state issued the Arizona voter photo identification card and a unique identifying number.
(section) Sec. 2: Title 16, chapter 4, article 9, Arizona Revised Statutes, is amended by adding section 16-567, to read: (para B)
(quote) B. An Arizona voter photo identification card is intended for use only for voting, and only for registered voters who do not possess other acceptable forms of identification.
(section) Sec. 2: Title 16, chapter 4, article 9, Arizona Revised Statutes, is amended by adding section 16-567, to read: (para B)
(quote) A registered voter is not ELIGIBLE to receive an Arizona VOTER photo identification card if the registered voter has a valid unexpired Arizona driver license or a valid unexpired Arizona nonoperating identification license or any other valid unexpired form of identification prescribed in section 16-579, subsection A, paragraph 1.
(section) Sec. 2: Title 16, chapter 4, article 9, Arizona Revised Statutes, is amended by adding section 16-567, to read: (para D)
(quote) D. An Arizona voter photo identification card is valid only as identification for voting purposes and as long as the person remains a registered voter and resides at the address SPECIFIED on the card.
(section) Sec. 2: Title 16, chapter 4, article 9, Arizona Revised Statutes, is amended by adding section 16-567, to read: (para D)
(quote) A person with an Arizona voter photo identification card whose residence address changes SHALL surrender the card and apply for a new Arizona voter photo identification card with the new address.
(section) Sec. 2: Title 16, chapter 4, article 9, Arizona Revised Statutes, is amended by adding section 16-567, to read: (para D)
(quote) If a person with an Arizona voter photo identification card moves out of this state or is otherwise no longer ELIGIBLE to vote IN this state, the person shall surrender the card to the secretary of state.END_STATUTE
(b_no_id_remedy)
(section) Sec. 1: Section 16-579, Arizona Revised Statutes, is amended to read:
(quote) a valid form of identification that bears the photograph, name and address of the elector that reasonably appear to be the same as the name and address in the precinct register and that does not note on its face that the identification is expired.
(section) Sec. 1: Section 16-579, Arizona Revised Statutes, is amended to read: (para 2)
(quote) 2. If the elector does not present identification that complies with paragraph 1 of this subsection, the elector is only eligible to vote a provisional ballot as prescribed by section 16-584 or a conditional provisional ballot as provided for in the secretary of state's instruction and procedures manual adopted pursuant to section 16-452.
(section) Sec. 2: Title 16, chapter 4, article 9, Arizona Revised Statutes, is amended by adding section 16-567, to read: (para A)
(quote) A. On application to The secretary of state and without charge, the secretary of state shall issue an Arizona voter photo IDENTIFICATION card to persons who are registered voters and who are eligible as prescribed in this section.
(section) Sec. 2: Title 16, chapter 4, article 9, Arizona Revised Statutes, is amended by adding section 16-567, to read: (para 1)
(quote) If the document does not include a photograph of the applicant, the submittal is sufficient if it includes both the applicant's full legal name and date of birth.
(c_mail_ballot_id) not stated.
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.

(section) Sec. 1: Section 16-579, Arizona Revised Statutes, is amended to read:
(quote) The valid form of identification shall be one of the following:
(section) Sec. 1: Section 16-579, Arizona Revised Statutes, is amended to read:
(quote) (b) A tribal enrollment card or other form of tribal identification.
(section) Sec. 1: Section 16-579, Arizona Revised Statutes, is amended to read:
(quote) (c) A United States federal, state or local government issued identification.
(section) Sec. 1: Section 16-579, Arizona Revised Statutes, is amended to read:
(quote) (e) An employee identification card for an employee of the United States government, this state, a city, town, county or school district in this state or any other political subdivision of this state.
(section) Sec. 1: Section 16-579, Arizona Revised Statutes, is amended to read:
(quote) (f) A student or EMPLOYEE identification card for a private or public college, including a community college, a university or a postgraduate or technical school that is located in this state.
(section) Sec. 1: Section 16-579, Arizona Revised Statutes, is amended to read:
(quote) (g) A United States MILITARY identification card.
(section) Sec. 2: Title 16, chapter 4, article 9, Arizona Revised Statutes, is amended by adding section 16-567, to read: (para 1)
(quote) 1. Documentation showing the full legal name and a photograph of the applicant.
